name: ComicView: Rooftop Series
overview: A revival of BET's iconic stand-up comedy franchise ComicView: Rooftop Series - BET Series BET Revives ‘ComicView’ With New ‘Rooftop Series’ Hosted by Chris ‘Cp’ Powell. Hosted by comedian Chris "CP" Powell, the show features emerging and established comedians delivering sharp, unfiltered takes on culture, family, and real life from a Hollywood rooftop.
